description:
One-shot spec/section retrieval: full content of the most relevant datasheet
segments for one or more parts (fuses search+get_segments). Already groups results per
part (via `parts`), so prefer `lookup` over `search` when you know the part(s).

parts.description: Part numbers to scope and group the retrieval by; results are returned per part.
parts.title: Parts

query.description: What to retrieve, e.g. 'supply voltage' or 'absolute maximum ratings'.
query.title: Query

name: lookup
title: Look up datasheet sections
